name: ULN2003A Darlington array
description: ULN2003A seven-channel Darlington transistor array: each output sinks to GND while its input is high (2.4 V or more through the part's 2.7 kOhm base resistor), with the data sheet's saturation voltage (0.9 V at 100 mA) and 0.25 us propagation delay; outputs only sink. Drives relays, lamps and the 28BYJ-48 stepper.

functional.claims: Seven inverting open-collector channels: an output sinks while its input is high (2.4 V or more) and is released otherwise, with no supply pin.
omissions: the clamp diodes from each output to COM (an inductive load's kick is not simulated)
the current limits (500 mA an output) and the package's dissipation
the input current (0.93 mA at 3.85 V)
outputs paralleled for more current sharing it

timed.claims: Seven inverting open-collector channels: an output sinks while its input is high (2.4 V or more) and is released otherwise, with no supply pin. Outputs switch 0.25 us after their inputs.
omissions: the clamp diodes from each output to COM (an inductive load's kick is not simulated)
the current limits (500 mA an output) and the package's dissipation

electrical.claims: Inputs switch at 2.4 V; an output on holds 0.7 V behind 2 Ohm (the data sheet's 0.9 V at 100 mA, 1.1 V at 200 mA); off it is open. The behaviour is the Lua model's.
